title: Tableau vertex index
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $n$, $t$, and $j$ be natural numbers. The vertex index for bit $j$ of tableau block $t$ is the base index $n+2+tW$ plus the embedding offset of output $j$ among $M$'s tableau update circuits, where $W$ is the tableau width of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
